item.title: Said & Checked, California, 2026-11-18: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Bruce Westerman)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Bruce Westerman, U.S. Representative from Arkansas: “Originally, the Tribe's reservation spanned over 15,000 acres until the city of San Diego initiated a land sale in 1931 so it could build the El Capitan Reservoir.” Unsettled. The Capitan Grande Reservation covered 15,753 acres, which matches 'over 15,000 acres', and the El Capitan Reservoir flooded its core in 1931 (as compiled by Wikipedia). A summary of a UC Irvine article cites purchase acts of 1919 and 1932, so the year the sale began is not confirmed.

6 statements by 2 officeholders. 1 checked: 1 unsettled · 4 not yet checked · 1 not checkable.
